description: This file defines the LoopWriter class, which extends java.io.Writer and implements the freemarker.template.TransformControl interface. It provides control methods for transforming template processing, likely used within FreeMarker templates for controlling loop execution.

classes.name: LoopWriter
classes.description: A Writer implementation that also provides control during FreeMarker template transformations, such as starting and ending evaluation, and handling errors.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Returns a code indicating whether to evaluate the body of the transformation; here, it always returns EVALUATE_BODY.

methods.name: afterBody
methods.description: Returns a code indicating whether to end evaluation after the body; here, it always returns END_EVALUATION.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during transformation; here it simply rethrows any throwable encountered.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes characters to the underlying stream; empty implementation.
